scope: PPO public numerical correctness; no model, dependency, training recipe, stateful PPO or biological mechanism changes.

input_fingerprints.source_manifest_format: SHA256 of compact JSON sorted by relative path: baseline source keys plus two new test paths, using current file hashes.

reproduction_command:
python3 - <<'PY' > evidence/LRN-09/objective-numerics-20261006/integrity.log
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess
p=Path('evidence/LRN-09/objective-numerics-20261006')
b=json.loads((p/'baseline.json').read_text())
sha=lambda path:hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
bad=[f for f,h in b['protected'].items() if not Path(f).is_file() or sha(f)!=h]
changed=[f for f,h in b['source'].items() if sha(f)!=h]
assert not bad,bad
assert changed==['learning/rl/objective.go'],changed
assert sha('learning/rl/objective_numerical_test.go')=='6366c25e66820665e066ff6ad50e460d0aa3e70c03bbde0681ae56259ed66499'
assert sha('learning/rl/objective_review_test.go')=='c4924936181177a34d7fa2e5a799b0a237fd1d2acef9511fcff8c4e82b904815'
base=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',b['commit']+':learning/rl/objective.go']).decode()
current=Path('learning/rl/objective.go').read_text()
for name in ['LogProb','Loss']:
    sig=r'^func '+name+r'\([^\n]+'
    assert re.search(sig,base,re.M).group()==re.search(sig,current,re.M).group(),name
sources={f:sha(f) for f in b['source']}
for f in ['learning/rl/objective_numerical_test.go','learning/rl/objective_review_test.go']:
    sources[f]=sha(f)
print(json.dumps({'existing_source_changes':changed,'protected_files_checked':len(b['protected']),'protected_files_changed':bad,'source_count':len(sources),'source_manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sources,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest(),'public_signatures_unchanged':True,'frozen_tests_unchanged':True},indent=2))
